leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a search input component with controlled state management
Configure asynchronous search functions with proper error handling
Apply request cancellation logic to prevent outdated responses
Construct a debounced search handler to optimize API calls
Initialize and update loading states during search operations
Render search results conditionally based on response validity
Integrate race condition safeguards into the complete search workflow
lessonTitle: Build race condition safe search UI
